description: This file contains unit tests for Unix socket message handling, including file descriptor passing, credentials, and socket communication using Google Test framework.

classes.name: UnixSocketMessage
classes.description: Represents a message sent over a Unix socket, including data and control messages such as file descriptors or credentials.

classes.name: UnixMessageSocket
classes.description: Encapsulates a Unix socket for message passing, supporting sending and receiving messages with optional credentials and file descriptors.

classes.name: ControlMessage
classes.description: Represents ancillary control messages for passing file descriptors or credentials over Unix sockets.

methods.name: CreateMemFDWithData
methods.description: Creates an in-memory file descriptor and writes the provided data into it.

methods.name: ReadAllFDData
methods.description: Reads all data from a given shared file descriptor.

methods.name: UnixMessageSocketPair
methods.description: Creates a pair of connected Unix message sockets.
